Question page canonical URL omits the title slug when the permalink setting is question-ID-by-short-ID.
Server-rendered HTML question page is not described in the Swagger documents, which cover /answer/api/v1 JSON endpoints.
Gitspace create accepts a new code_repo_ref field and internal repos are resolved by it instead of code_repo_url; actions fail without a ref.
Create request schema lists code_repo_url etc. but no code_repo_ref; repo resolution rule not stated.
Requests with an unknown HTTP method now end with the 405 response, marked handled so no further handler processes them.
No checked-in contract; change applies to any path requested with an unsupported method.
Artifact/version creation records the authenticated principal as owner explicitly; update-via-create paths now enforce artifact write authorization.
owner field appears untyped/undescribed; no 403 or owner derivation rule documented for these operations.
Entra ID sessions with expired access tokens now attempt silent renewal (throttled after failure) and refresh group memberships used for access filtering.
Internal session token renewal; contract describes search and sessions but not Entra ID token refresh or group re-reading.
Kafka operations now run on a bounded executor; when overloaded the bridge returns 503 'Bridge is overloaded, please retry later'.
Operations documented but no 503 response or overload behaviour appears anywhere in the contract.
Multipart file uploads missing the file or fileName part are now rejected with an error.
No checked-in contract document; new required-part validation on multipart bodies.
Validation error messages in error-field responses are now capitalised and end with a period.
Applies to all validated requests; contract has no error_msg schema or message-format statement.
When cancelling runs with reusable-workflow callers, caller jobs take status from their children's aggregation instead of being cancelled directly.
Cancel operation summary only says it cancels a run and its jobs; caller status aggregation not described.
Without a stored rule, config GET returns the configured default global compatibility instead of NONE; setting NONE stores a rule instead of deleting it.
Config operations described generically; no fallback default or NONE-deletes-rule semantics stated.
